sentences.text: This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical) Mode.

2. Heard learned counsel appearing for the appellant.
3.
This is an application seeking grant of interim bail on the ground that Petitioner's mother is suffering from hemiparesis and there is nobody to look after her for her medical treatment.

4. It is contended that the Appellant has been convicted for the offence under Section 376-A(b) of I.P.C and Section 6 of the POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo the imprisonment for a period of 25 years and pay a fine of Rs.25,000/- vide its judgment dt.23.09.2022.
5.
It is accordingly contended that Petitioner be released on interim bail for about 4 months on such terms and conditions as deem fit and proper.

Learned Addl. Govt. Advocate on being directed produced the instruction provided by the I.I.C, G.
Udayagiri P.S-Kandhmal.
The same be kept on record.

sentences.text: Basing on the instruction, it is contended that in fact Petitioner's mother is suffering from severe hyper tension with left hemiparesis.
The patient in the meantime has also been referred for further treatment.

However, it is contended that taking into account the nature of offence and the period of sentence imposed, stringent conditions be imposed, if this Court is inclined to release the appellant on interim bail.

8. Having heard learned counsel appearing for the parties and considering the submission made and the report furnished by the learned Addl. Govt Advocate, this Court is inclined to allow the application and direct for release of the appellant on interim bail for a period of two (2) months from the date of his release subject to such terms and conditions as deem fit and proper to be imposed by the learned court in seisin.
8.1. It is however observed that the appellant-Petitioner shall surrender immediately after completion of the interim bail period.
9. The I.A stands disposed of accordingly.
